destinations.title: Explore Albania in Your Hire Car from Tirana Airport
destinations.subtitle: With Mother Teresa Airport (TIA) as your starting point, the whole of Albania is within reach
destinations.intro: A car rental tirana airport trip opens the door to one of Europe's most stunning and overlooked countries. Albania greets you with sparkling Adriatic and Ionian beaches, UNESCO-listed towns, ancient Illyrian ruins and rugged mountains — each only a few hours by road from the airport. These are the spots our customers return to again and again:

places.name: Durrës — 35 km · 30 min
places.desc: The country's leading coastal city and its favourite beach escape. Walk the broad Adriatic shoreline, explore one of the Balkans' largest Roman amphitheaters and soak up the buzzing seaside promenade. An easy day trip right from Tirana Airport.

places.name: Berat — 120 km · 1h 30min
places.desc: A UNESCO World Heritage town and one of the most-photographed corners of Albania, known as the 'City of a Thousand Windows.' Its beautifully preserved old quarter follows the Osum River beneath a medieval hilltop castle with panoramic valley views.

places.name: Vlorë — 150 km · 2h
places.desc: The entry point to the Albanian Riviera and the place where independence was proclaimed in 1912. Set between clear Adriatic and Ionian seas, Vlorë makes a perfect base for the Llogara Pass, the Karaburun Peninsula and the villages of the southern coast.

places.name: Shkodër — 110 km · 1h 20min
places.desc: The cultural heart of northern Albania and the gateway to the Albanian Alps. Hike up to Rozafa Castle for lake views, explore the old bazaar and make Shkodër your launch pad for the Accursed Mountains — some of Europe's last untamed wilderness.

places.name: Sarandë — 280 km · 3h 30min
places.desc: The crown of the Albanian Riviera and one of the Mediterranean's hidden gems. Wander the ancient ruins of Butrint (UNESCO), plunge into the turquoise Blue Eye spring and relax on Ksamil's white sands. Perfect for a 4–5 day road trip out of Tirana Airport.

rentalGuide.title: What to Know Before You Collect Your Car at the Airport
rentalGuide.subtitle: A short guide to collecting your car at Tirana Airport

items.title: Documents required for airport car rental
items.desc: Renting a car at Tirana Airport calls for three items: a driving license you've held for at least a year, a national ID or passport, and a credit or debit card for the refundable deposit. We accept EU and international licenses, and most nationalities face no additional paperwork.

items.title: Age limits and the young-driver rule
items.desc: You must be at least 21 to rent at Tirana Airport. Those between 21 and 25 might pay a young-driver surcharge that varies with the car category. There is no upper age cap. Each driver needs a valid license and must appear on the rental agreement.

items.title: Insurance and coverage explained
items.desc: Basic CDW insurance is built into every car in our Tirana Airport fleet at no extra charge, covering damage past the standard excess. During online booking you can step up to Super CDW for complete zero-excess protection — highly recommended for Albania's mountain and coastal roads.

items.title: Driving in Albania — what to expect
items.desc: The main roads in Albania are modern and well-maintained. The SH2 highway connects Tirana Airport to downtown in roughly 20 minutes. The Riviera coast roads and mountain passes are gorgeous but narrower, so an SUV is the safer bet for off-the-beaten-path routes. Signs meet European standards; speed limits run 50 km/h in town, 80 on main roads and 110 on highways.

home.seoText: Rent Ride offers car rental throughout Albania, based directly at Tirana International Airport (Mother Teresa Airport — TIA) and downtown. Whether you're looking up rent car tirana airport for business travel, a family break along the Albanian Riviera, or a longer road trip across the Western Balkans, our modern fleet, transparent all-inclusive pricing and dedicated airport meet & greet are why thousands of travelers pick us every year. Visitors from Italy, Germany, the UK, the US, Kosovo and further afield rely on us for dependable, affordable car rental albania tirana airport. Reserve online in under 2 minutes — with free cancellation, instant confirmation and no hidden fees.

items.question: How does booking work?
items.answer: Pick your car, fill out the booking form with your dates and details, and confirm. The confirmation email lands in your inbox right away.

items.question: What documents are required?
items.answer: Bring a valid driver's license (held at least 1 year), an ID card or passport, and a credit/debit card for the deposit.

items.question: Can I pick up the car from the airport?
items.answer: Absolutely! Pickup and return at Mother Teresa International Airport (TIA) come free of charge. Our team greets you at arrivals — no surcharge and no waiting around.

items.question: Is there any extra fee for airport pickup?
items.answer: No. Rent car tirana airport pickup and return are entirely free of any surcharge. Whatever price you see at booking is the full amount.

items.question: How do I find you at Tirana Airport?
items.answer: Once you've landed, make your way to the arrivals hall, where our representative is holding a sign with your name. You're also welcome to call us any time at +355 69 81 45 803.

items.question: What happens if the car breaks down?
items.answer: Assistance is available around the clock. We'll dispatch help or a replacement car straight away, with no extra charge.

items.question: Can I cancel my booking?
items.answer: Yes — cancellation is free up to 24 hours before pickup. Beyond that point a cancellation fee is charged.

items.question: Which cars can I find at the airport?
items.answer: The Tirana Airport fleet spans economy cars from €25/day up to spacious family SUVs, premium luxury models and modern automatics. Each vehicle is regularly serviced, cleaned ahead of every rental and less than 4 years old. On the fleet page you can filter by category, transmission and price.

items.question: Can I drop the car off at the airport anytime?
items.answer: Yes — returns at Tirana International Airport are accepted 24/7, holidays included. Just share your return flight when you book and we take care of the rest. No surcharge applies for night, early-morning or weekend returns.

items.question: Does the rental price include an airport surcharge?
items.answer: Not a cent — our airport surcharge is zero. The rate is identical whether you collect at Tirana Airport or our downtown office, which puts us among the few car rental tirana airport companies with genuinely transparent pricing at both locations.

items.question: How far is the airport from central Tirana?
items.answer: Mother Teresa International Airport (TIA) lies roughly 17 km northwest of central Tirana. Via the SH2 highway the trip takes 20–25 minutes in typical traffic. Our tirana airport rent a car service lets you bypass costly taxis and packed buses and head straight where you're going.
